_doc: KNOWN, REVIEWED schema-drift exceptions consumed by scripts/schema-drift-check.mjs (--ignore). Every entry is an explicit decision, never a silent skip. Entries here are prod ORPHANS with NO code references whose exact DDL could not be committed by CC (no prod-DDL access); they await a founder decision: capture-from-prod (pg_dump -t) and formalize as a migration, OR DROP from prod. Remove the entry the moment the object is formalized or dropped — the check then re-enforces it.

_rationale.sites.custom_domain*: Prod-only columns, NO code reference anywhere (git grep custom_domain in api/dashboard = empty). Exact column names/types unknown to CC. Capture via `pg_dump --schema-only -t sites` from prod, or DROP.
_rationale.site_annotations.*: Table exists in prod only, NO code reference anywhere, NO CREATE migration. Exact DDL unknown to CC. Capture via `pg_dump --schema-only -t site_annotations` from prod, or DROP.
